name: dusk-glass
description: Lavender-dusk colours and a living dusk sky behind the Claude desktop app's conversation: fireflies that glow up one or two at a time, a little pen-drawn bee, and three flowers growing out of the corner. Optional Comic Sans for the chat.

font.title: Chat font
font.description: comic-sans draws the conversation in Comic Sans (Windows; other systems show their own cursive font). app-default keeps the app's font.
